notes: Browser tests (a .spec.ts file importing @playwright/test) run against `node engine/src/main.ts serve`, which must listen on 127.0.0.1:$PEERAXIS_PORT and read cards from $PEERAXIS_HOME/peeraxis.sqlite. scripts/acceptance.sh seeds that home with engine/test/seed.ts first; the seeded card ids are in the JSON file at $PEERAXIS_SEED (keys: project, second, waiting, building, parked, accepted, draft). Seeded cards: 'Greeting says hello' is waiting for a verdict and has a recording (video.webm) and a screenshot; 'Farewell says goodbye' is building; 'Dark mode for the settings page' is approved; 'Import contacts from a file' is parked with the reason "Parked: the project's own check fails before any change, so nothing was built."; 'Title is bold' is accepted; 'Show the date each feature finished' is a draft card that has not been approved yet (state draft). Which model does which job is stored in $PEERAXIS_HOME/models.json (read with loadModels in engine/src/models.ts). Use relative URLs; baseURL is set. Other test files run with node --test after the same seeding. Mac notifications are shown with osascript; when PEERAXIS_NOTIFY_FILE is set, the text of each notification is appended as one line to that file instead of being shown, so tests can check it. Intake (turning one typed sentence into a drafted card) normally asks the intake model from models.json; when PEERAXIS_INTAKE_SCRIPT names a JSON file (acceptance runs set it to engine/test/fixtures/intake.json), intake reads it instead: {"questions": [{"question", "recommended", "options"}], "card": {title, before, after, watch, notIncluded}}. With that script, typing any sentence asks "Should a pinned feature stay pinned after you accept it?" with the recommended answer "No, unpin it when accepted", and answering drafts the card "Pin a feature to the top". The seed has two projects: "sample-project" (all the cards above) and "second-project" (one accepted card, 'Second project is set up'). A project's name on screen is its folder name.
